usage:
require "openai"

client = Openai::Client.new(api_key: ENV["OPENAI_API_KEY"])

result = client.vector_stores.files.list("vector_store_id", limit: 20, order: "asc", after: "after", before: "before", filter: "in_progress")
pp result

typeReference.signature: client.vector_stores.files.list(vector_store_id, limit: nil, order: nil, after: nil, before: nil, filter: nil) -> Page<Models::VectorStoreFileObject>

fields.name: limit
fields.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 20.

fields.name: order
fields.description: Sort order by the `created_at` timestamp of the objects. `asc` for ascending order and `desc` for descending order.

fields.name: after
fields.description: A cursor for use in pagination. `after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include after=obj_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list.

fields.name: before
fields.description: A cursor for use in pagination. `before` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include before=obj_foo in order to fetch the previous page of the list.

fields.name: filter
fields.description: Filter by file status. One of `in_progress`, `completed`, `failed`, `cancelled`.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The identifier, which can be referenced in API endpoints.

fields.name: object
fields.description: The object type, which is always `vector_store.file`.

fields.name: usage_bytes
fields.description: The total vector store usage in bytes. Note that this may be different from the original file size.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the vector store file was created.

fields.name: vector_store_id
fields.description: The ID of the [vector store](/docs/api-reference/vector-stores/object) that the [File](/docs/api-reference/files) is attached to.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The status of the vector store file, which can be either `in_progress`, `completed`, `cancelled`, or `failed`. The status `completed` indicates that the vector store file is ready for use.

fields.name: chunking_strategy
fields.description: The strategy used to chunk the file.
